appointment_attendance_check_in_check.name: appointment_attendance_check_in_check
appointment_attendance_check_in_check.value: ("appointment_attendance"."token_number" is null and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is null and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_by" is null) or ("appointment_attendance"."token_number" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."token_number" > 0 and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_by" is not null)

appointment_attendance_actor_pairs_check.name: appointment_attendance_actor_pairs_check
appointment_attendance_actor_pairs_check.value: ("appointment_attendance"."started_at" is null) = ("appointment_attendance"."started_by" is null) and ("appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is null) = ("appointment_attendance"."terminal_by" is null)

appointment_attendance_state_check.name: appointment_attendance_state_check
appointment_attendance_state_check.value:
("appointment_attendance"."status" = 'waiting' and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."started_at" is null and "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is null) or
    ("appointment_attendance"."status" = 'in_service' and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."started_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is null) or
    ("appointment_attendance"."status" = 'completed' and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."started_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is not null) or
    ("appointment_attendance"."status" = 'no_show' and "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is null and "appointment_attendance"."started_at" is null and "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is not null) or
    ("appointment_attendance"."status" = 'cancelled' and "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is not null)

appointment_attendance_time_check.name: appointment_attendance_time_check
appointment_attendance_time_check.value: ("appointment_attendance"."started_at" is null or ("appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at" is not null and "appointment_attendance"."started_at" >= "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at")) and ("appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" is null or "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at" >= coalesce("appointment_attendance"."started_at", "appointment_attendance"."checked_in_at", "appointment_attendance"."terminal_at"))

doctor_profile_review_state_check.name: doctor_profile_review_state_check
doctor_profile_review_state_check.value: ("doctor_profile"."status" = 'pending' and "doctor_profile"."reviewed_at" is null and "doctor_profile"."reviewed_by" is null) or ("doctor_profile"."status" <> 'pending' and "doctor_profile"."reviewed_at" is not null and "doctor_profile"."reviewed_by" is not null)

staff_registration_review_check.name: staff_registration_review_check
staff_registration_review_check.value: ("staff_registration_request"."status" = 'pending' and "staff_registration_request"."reviewed_at" is null and "staff_registration_request"."reviewed_by" is null) or ("staff_registration_request"."status" = 'approved' and "staff_registration_request"."reviewed_at" is not null and "staff_registration_request"."reviewed_by" is not null)
